# Rawafed Al Nile for Investment and Development

Official website: https://rawafedalnile.com/
Arabic name: روافد النيل للاستثمار والتنمية
Logo: https://rawafedalnile.com/assets/rawafed-logo.webp

## Company

Rawafed Al Nile is an Egyptian investment and development company. Its core business sectors are tourism and travel services, petroleum services, business consulting, electromechanical works, public supplies, and contracting and construction.

## Leadership

- Major General Nehad Samir — Founder and Chairman.
- Engineer Sherif Omran — Vice Chairman.
- Major General Mostafa Omran — Vice Chairman – Government Relations.

## Contact

- Email: info@rawafedalnile.com
- Cairo office: 26 Abdullah bin Taher, Zone 6, Nasr City, Cairo, Egypt.
- Giza office: Al-Majd Mall, 4th Floor, 6th of October City, Giza, Egypt.

## Site sections

The official website contains the company overview, sectors, project environments, leadership, and contact information in English and Arabic.
